title: You find my words dark. Darkness is in our souls do you not think? Flutier.
html_source: Stephen is rehearsing his sexy talk to a woman. He says “darkness is in our souls do you not think” and then says, that’s not good enough, it needs to be flutier. Then he goes on to this imaginary woman: “Our souls, shamewounded by our sins, cling to us yet more, a woman to her lover clinging, the more the more.” That’s sexier, Stephen thinks.
